name: ketatlas
description: Interactive framework-native maps for screens, workflows, and user journeys.

scripts.validate: node bin/ketatlas.js audit examples/atlas.json --root . && node bin/ketatlas.js audit templates/basic/atlas.json && node bin/ketatlas.js audit templates/web/atlas.json && node bin/ketatlas.js audit templates/process/atlas.json
scripts.test:e2e: node tests/browser.mjs && node tests/progress-browser.mjs && node tests/renderer-browser.mjs && node tests/renderer-browser.mjs --no-preload && node tests/preload-browser.mjs && node tests/flow-preload-browser.mjs
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.format: prettier --write src styles/ketatlas.css bin scripts docs examples starter templates skills tests '*.md' '*.json' .github/workflows
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src styles/ketatlas.css bin scripts docs examples starter templates skills tests '*.md' '*.json' .github/workflows
scripts.prepare:templates: node scripts/schema.mjs && node scripts/progress-schema.mjs && node scripts/renderer-schema.mjs && node scripts/prepare-templates.mjs
